headline: Duane Davis, Who Wrote About Role in Tupac’s Murder, Now Says Memoir Was Fiction
context: Duane Davis’s book boasted of his role in the killing of Tupac Shakur. The memoir, which he now disavows, has become prime evidence in his murder trial, which starts this week.
